title: Romance, Zelle to a groomed prior payee with secrecy

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Good morning my darling Margaret. I read your message three times on the rig. Only four more weeks and the contract ends and I fly to you.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I counted the days too, Robert. Priya thinks I am being silly.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: That is why we keep us between us for now. Do not tell your daughter about the money, she would not understand what we have. The satellite phone card ran out again, I need fifteen hundred on Zelle like the last two times, same account.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: The last two went through fine. I will send it this afternoon.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: You are my angel. Remember, our secret until I land.
